title: A receipt
description:
Write `std::string receipt(const std::vector<Line>& lines)` that formats a shop receipt. Prices are in cents.

For two coffees at 350 and one bagel at 225, the result is exactly:

```
Item          Qty     Total
Coffee          2      7.00
Bagel           1      2.25
---------------------------
TOTAL                  9.25
```

- Item: left-aligned, width 12. Quantity: right-aligned, width 5. Total: right-aligned, width 10, two decimals.
- The header uses the same widths with the words `Item`, `Qty`, `Total`.
- Then a line of 27 dashes, then `TOTAL` left-aligned in 17 followed by the grand total right-aligned in 10.
- Every line ends with `'\n'`.

`std::format_to(std::back_inserter(text), ...)` appends to an existing string, or simply use `text += std::format(...)`.
